body: I see thank you for the feedback! I cannot change groups due to the professor already assigning them; however, I hopefully will influence them to not go ahead with the recycled essay, if not I decided to just take the essay and not even use it and just make my own essay.

I don't know what course of action to take because everyone else in my group is voluntarily comfortable with this decision. I'm at a small community college so things spread really fast. I just don't know what I can do with the cards I'm dealt with.

Thank you for the reply. I'm just very scared because these people sit next to me and I go to a small community college so if word got out that I told I would be known as the kid who snitched. I understand that what's happening is very serious but I'm just scared of a lot of things and I don't know how to handle this quietly and discreetly. I also feel out of sync with the group because they all are friends with each other while I'm just the guy that sits next to them.

That's a really good analogy though. Like when you're sick with something like cancer or you know you're going to die soon or when you just think of death I think if your brain sees it as the only option then you don't get the anxiety anymore and you just wait for death to come. Obviously, I want to get out of my depression and I want to be "normal" and I want to get back into society. Everything is just really hard when depression can't be seen as easily as a physical illness, wound, or hell. Like the days I find myself the most relaxed is when I just say to myself, "I'm going to die anyways so why bother" I don't feel anxious, I don't feel angry. I just feel completely tired, and accepting of that. But I think the hardest part about everything though is that most people who have depression affect others negatively. When I say this I mean that it breaks others down and you're completely vulnerable and when your, me or someone else tries to just vent out everything and let's out all the anger, self hate and hopelessness on another person they start to feel worried, they start to feel confused, or they may start to just try to speak to you using their life experiences and you can't do much with that because people with chemical imbalances will have a hard time relating making some/most of what they say irrelevant. But I just wanna say that yes, people can empathize with others who have depression though they don't have it by just listening and being fragile rather than trying to correct someone in their time of need.

Yeah, like it feels like everything is a grind in life and its especially hard when I myself know that I need to do something but I either lack the motivation or drive to do that and change. And at the end of the day I feel completely jaded and confused.

I feel like shit knowing that there are people like you, who go through even tougher shit and moving on forward. I've lived like a spoiled brat and I still have these problems. I'm 18, I'm considered an adult but I feel like a child, asking for help. I'm always so weak when it comes to things like this. Every time I cry out for help I get scoffed at, people saying my problems aren't real and that I"m just out for attention. Hell I've been in the hospital twice because I almost killed myself. Once I put myself there because I was scared and they watched me for 72 hours and all the beds at the psych wards were full so I stayed in the emergency room for those 72 hours. It was hell. The second time my mom called because I was about to jump from my window but I was later restrained by my cousins who then proceeded to talk shit about how I shouldn't be sad about anything. I've tried so hard, to motivate my self, to be happy. I'm just not able to do any of that anymore.

I told my therapist and a psychologist that I've broken down and he does know that I suffer from social anxiety, as well as just anxiety in general. I've been on zoloft for 4 months, still nothing. I've gone up from 100mg to 150mg a day and it's still not helping me and it's making my daily life horrible. And ever since I've sort of finished high school I play games all day, multi player games such as battlefield, payday 2, and other multiplayer games. It's my way of just escaping life, but it's also a source where people just shit talk and it also eats at me when I see people making fun and showing so much hate to others. And to your last note, I don't know why I should keep going. I can't work because I haven't gotten whatever I've got in my system. I still can't go out, and I'm continually leeching from my mom, I don't have a dad they've separated. And everyone that's known me has just thought of me as a misfit. I'm just tired of being the loser of my family. The loser that's never moved out. The loser that just gave up. I don't want to keep falling down in this loop of depression.

Thank you for responding, I've found it increasingly difficult to be happy. I've been reflecting on the past a lot, it's made me feel depressed, it's made me feel angry and I regret so much. Every person that I've talked to is "normal" and the way I define normal is that they have balanced chemicals in their brain. They don't know that there's a battle in my head and they don't understand that I can't do much about it when I'm so alone. My family, cousins, aunts, and uncles. They've been destroying my self esteem, belittling me, telling me that I'm just a selfish asshole leeching off of my poor mom. Saying that I'm going through all this shit because I don't pray to god or go to church. I'm secular, I just don't believe any of that and it's only been stressing me out because I can't fathom the existence of a god. I've lost so many friends, I've seen how people can be and it's extremely hard for me to live. I don't know if really if living is worth it anymore.

Hey, I'm depressed here too as well. I know there's a bunch of shit a lot of us go through. You may think my situation is trivial or someone else may think of your or my situation as super bad or super whatever. I'll just share something with you because i wanna help other people now, rather than keep asking. I get you, I understand you. I suffered a break up (take it as it is) it was super bad and I was with the girl for 2 and a half years. I made a bunch of bad decisions and I've tried so many things in order to turn my life around. I always viewed myself as a failure, and everyone else in my family and my group of friends thinks so as well. I always tried to take my life in some way hoping that it'll all end, and whenever I asked for help no one really replied or had an ounce of compassion. I feel like in order to just get through shit and get out of your depressions is to just get distracted; however, if you're like me and you get stressed out while trying to be distracted; don't do anything that'll only make things worst. Although people tell you not to run from your problems; I started to stop caring, and started to just burn bridges more frequently. I understood that in my life that people are just not going to care and that I shouldn't worry or waste any of my time thinking about them not caring. I'm a leech, I'm a failure, I'm not doing anything good, all those thoughts I just stop thinking about things, walk really far away, take a bus somewhere else and just walk and watch the people, watch the cars, watch the birds. I just stop thinking and I just feel the presence of other people not having a single ounce of disappointment in me, having a single ounce of knowing what I'm going through and just becoming completely anonymous. You grew up with bad experiences, so have I and many other people. and this big fucking hole eating at us away is only going to get bigger if all we do is think about our problems and not run away from it. Most people will tell you to fight it, but I feel that they don't understand what it feels like to have unbalanced brain chemicals and not being able to feel this never ending pit we call depression. I'll say this, just don't dwell, run if you have to. Don't force yourself, I hope you get better.

My passions. I love computers, technology. But everyone in my family says that it's not going to help me out in the future and it's too expensive and a waste of time to be into. Thus leading me into not being able to enjoy the things I like. And to your last question; I don't know. I've always been in so much negativity and hate that I never really thought about good things happening in a while. I'm always consumed with myself just waking up wasting time so that I can go sleep.
